name: Bug Fables: April Fools!
source:
Bee’s back at school, and everything is… chaotic. Between flirty glances from Beetle, mysterious Zasp, and her over-affectionate best friend, love – and disaster – might just be around the corner.

[From [url=https://paperbugdev.itch.io/bug-fables-april]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蜜蜂回到学校，一切都变得……混乱。在甲壳虫、神秘的扎斯普和她过于深情的好朋友的挑逗目光之间，爱情——和灾难——可能就在眼前。

[来自[url=https://paperbugdev.itch.io/bug-fables-april]Itch.io[/url]]
